parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the vulnerability.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedVul](~~DescribeGroupedVul~~) or [DescribeVulList](~~DescribeVulList~~) operation to query the names of vulnerabilities.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

*   **cve**: Linux software vulnerability
*   **sys**: Windows system vulnerability
*   **cms**: Web-CMS vulnerability
*   **app**: application vulnerabilitiy
*   **emg**: urgent vulnerability
*   **sca**: vulnerability that is detected based on software component analysis

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-vul-details --lang zh --type sca --name SCA:ACSV-2020-052801 --alias-name RHSA-2019:3197-Important:_sudo_security_update --resource-directory-account-id 1276085894170000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeVulDetails --region cn-hangzhou --Type sca --AliasName 'RHSA-2019:3197-Important:_sudo_security_update' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1276085894170000 --Lang zh --Name 'SCA:ACSV-2020-052801'
